sources.title: Groundwater body BG3G00000NQ018

municipality_lithology_searches.note: Targeted internet search for individual borehole lithological columns, engineering-geological logs, hydrogeological reports and exploration boreholes. No new publicly extractable individual borehole column with exact depth-resolved intervals was confirmed. The strongest lead is the Kurtovo Konare marble deposit, where official documents confirm exploration drilling and tracing of the marble massif by boreholes to 71.9 m. The Kurtovo Konare groundwater monitoring well is kept separately as monitoring-only evidence.

Targeted internet search for real lithological columns, engineering-geological borehole logs and geological reports in Maritsa municipality. No new publicly extractable locality-verified individual borehole lithological column was confirmed.
